content: Stripe webhook handlers must be idempotent -- Stripe retries on any non-2xx or timeout, so the same event can arrive multiple times. Standard pattern: unique constraint on stored Stripe event id, insert-first, treat constraint collision as 'already handled' and return 200 immediately. Do not trust event payload snapshots for ordering-sensitive state; on ambiguous/out-of-order events, refetch the live subscription object from the Stripe API and project that as truth. Treat the local DB as a cache of Stripe's state, not the source of truth.
